    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Agent
    Represents an agent that can perform operations in a messaging-based system.
    BinOpAgent
    An agent that takes two inputs and produces a single output.
    Config
    Represents a configuration interface with basic operations for creating, managing, and closing configurations.
    ConfigDelete
    Removes the active configuration entirely: closes all agents, clears every topic, and discards the stored graph and configuration.
    ConfigError
    Lists every error condition that can occur while loading, validating, or rendering a computational-graph configuration.
    ConfigError.Severity
    Drives the error page's color and icon; not tied to a specific error type.
    ConfigException
    Thrown when a configuration cannot be loaded, validated, or turned into a graph.
    ConfigReset
    Rebuilds the deployed graph from its saved configuration, clearing all topic values and agents current states.
    ConfLoader
    Loads and deploys a configuration from a multipart request with a .conf file.
    CounterAgent
    Counts the total number of messages received on the input topic since creation or last reset.
    FilesRepository
    A file Repository to manage files, keyed by the file name.
    FileUtils
    A File Utilization class to help read and write files.
    GenericConfig
    The GenericConfig class is an implementation of the Config interface.
    Graph
    Represents a directed graph of topics and agents.
    GraphDisplayer
    Handles the request to display the current graph.
    GraphRepository
    A repository for managing graphs.
    GraphService
    Service class responsible for managing and operating the graph data structure.
    HtmlErrorWriter
    Html helper class for displaying the error messages to the client in a pleasing way.
    HtmlGraphWriter
    Generates HTML that visually represents the computational graph.
    HtmlLoader
    Loads static HTML files from the specified directory.
    HTTPServer
    Represents an HTTP server that can be used to handle HTTP requests with specific servlets registered for different HTTP commands and URI paths.
    IncAgent
    An agent that takes one input and sends theinput + 1 to an output Topic.
    LocalFilesRepository
    Stores files inside a single application-owned directory.
    LocalGraphRepository
     
    Main
     
    MathematicalDescribable
    An interface for classes that has a mathematical expression
    MaxTrackerAgent
    Tracks the running maximum of all numeric values seen on the input topic.
    MediaType
    Enum representing standard Web Media types.
    Message
    Represents a message sent between agents.
    MinusAgent
    An agent that performs a subtraction operation on two input values and publishes the result to an output Topic.
    MovingAverageAgent
    Computes a moving average of the input numeric values.
    MulAgent
    An agent that takes two inputs and sends the multipcation to an output Topic.
    MultipartParser
    Utility class for parsing multipart/form-data bodies.
    MultipartParser.MultipartResult
     
    MyHTTPServer
    A simple HTTP server implmeantion that runs in a separate thread.
    Node
    Represents a node in the graph.
    NumberFormatter
    Formats numeric values for display
    ParallelAgent
    An active decorator to an agent for processesing messages asynchronously.
    PlusAgent
    An agent that takes two inputs sends and the sum to an output Topic.
    ReplaceUntrustedChars
    Replaces untrusted text at output (with the same safe values): html() for HTML content, js() for single-quoted JS strings.
    RequestParser
    A utility class for parsing HTTP request data from a BufferedReader into a structured format.
    RequestParser.RequestInfo
    A basic pojo for holding request info.
    ResponseUtils
    A utility class for generating HTTP responses.
    Servlet
    Defines a generic interface for handling HTTP requests and generating responses.
    StatusCode
    Enum representing HTTP status codes with their reasons.
    Topic
    Represents a topic - a messaging channel for a pub/sub architecture.
    TopicDisplayer
    TopicDisplayer is an implementation of the Servlet interface, responsible for handling requests related to the display and management of topics and their associated messages.
    TopicManagerSingleton
    Provides global, thread-safe access to the single TopicManagerSingleton.TopicManager instance.
    TopicManagerSingleton.TopicManager
     
    UnaryOpAgent
    An agent that takes a single input and produces a single output.
